mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 'active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 'active' WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.permission_key = 'asset.read' AND ((r.role_key = 'platform_admin' AND ur.scope_type = 'global' AND ur.scope_id = '*') OR (ur.scope_type = 'asset' AND ur.scope_id = CAST(a.id AS CHAR))) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asset a WHERE
SELECT a.id, a.asset_key, a.asset_type, a.environment, a.criticality, a.owner, a.status FROM asset a WHERE ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT a.id, a.asset_key, a.asset_type, a.environment, a.criticality, a.owner, a.status FROM asset a WHERE a.id = #{assetId} AND
mapper.update: UPDATE asset a SET criticality=#{criticality}, owner=#{owner}, status=#{status}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE a.id=#{assetId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND p.permission_key='asset.manage' AND ((r.role_key='platform_admin' AND ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*') OR (ur.scope_type='asset' AND ur.scope_id=CAST(a.id AS CHAR))) )
